
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/dylan-bky/p/19499016" title="发布于 2026-01-18 19:48">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">CompletableFuture处理超时</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>在当前的 BatchProcessingService 类中，所有异步任务均通过 CompletableFuture.supplyAsync() 提交，并使用了自定义的 taskExecutor 执行器。但目前 没有实现超时控制，即如果某个任务长时间不完成，也不会中断或返回超时结果。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> processWithTimeout(BatchRequest request,
                                   Consumer</span>&lt;ProcessResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> callback,
                                   CompletableFuture</span>&lt;ProcessResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> completableFuture) {

        CompletableFuture</span>&lt;ProcessResult&gt; future =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(
                () </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> businessService.dealBusiness(request), taskExecutor);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 超时 future</span>
        CompletableFuture&lt;ProcessResult&gt; timeoutFuture = CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> future.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 等待最多5秒</span>
            } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (TimeoutException e) {
                future.cancel(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 尝试取消原任务</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> CompletionException(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception("处理超时"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CompletionException(e);
            }
        }, taskExecutor);

        timeoutFuture.whenComplete((result, throwable) </span>-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (throwable != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                ProcessResult errorResult </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessResult(
                        request.getId(),
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        </span>"处理失败: " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> throwable.getMessage(),
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        </span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        (Exception) throwable.getCause()
                );
                callback.accept(errorResult);
                completableFuture.completeExceptionally(throwable);
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                callback.accept(result);
                completableFuture.complete(result);
            }
        });
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>手动 get(timeout) 控制增加超时处理</li>
</ul>
<p>输入API的请求参数如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[{
    </span>"id":"1"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
},
{
    </span>"id":"2"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
},
{
    </span>"id":"3"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
},
{
    </span>"id":"999"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}]</span></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>id为999的数据为超时处理</li>
<li>模拟超时的业务代码如下所示：</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟处理逻辑</span>
        String id =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> request.getId();
        Integer idInt </span>= Integer.valueOf(id) == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> ? 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> : Integer.valueOf(id);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟超时：当ID为特定值时，延迟较长时间</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (StringUtils.isNoneBlank(id) &amp;&amp; idInt == 999) { <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 假设999表示需要超时测试</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                Thread.sleep(</span>10000); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟10秒超时</span>
            } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ProcessResult(
                        request.getId(),
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        </span>"处理被中断"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        </span>-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                        e
                );
            }
        }</span></pre>
</div>
